summary: Panel authorization recovery and bounded requests

delivery.outcome: Publish clear panel authorization failures, bounded requests and local logout with browser regressions.
nonGoals: Gateway/UI release identity and production deployment
Changing grants, accessing credentials or calling a provider
Weakening OneDev sandbox or trusted publication

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing header helper and UI. Centralize bounded JSON requests and session cancellation; render only classified failures and discard stale results after logout.
architecture.rollback: Restore the previous index.html; no persisted data or gateway contract changes.

validation.evidence: Isolated Chromium and loopback gateway: auth and failure classification
Logout, late response and empty storage regressions
Managed scope gate and material browser tests
